Keynote at the 11th Symposium on Location-Based Services

On November 28th, 2014, Prof. Döllner gives a keynote talk entitled "Abstraction as Key Element of Map Application and Services" at the 11th Symposium on Location-Based Services (LBS), which is held in the city of Vienna from 26th-28th November, 2014.
